description: This file implements a PhotosHandler class for managing photo retrieval in an Android app, including permission handling, querying latest photos from device storage, resizing, encoding to JPEG, and building JSON payloads for external use.

classes.name: PhotosLatestRequest
classes.description: Data class representing parameters for fetching latest photos.

classes.name: EncodedPhotoPayload
classes.description: Data class representing a photo payload encoded in base64 with metadata.

classes.name: PhotosDataSource
classes.description: Interface defining the contract for photo data sources.

classes.name: SystemPhotosDataSource
classes.description: Singleton object implementing PhotosDataSource to access device's photo storage.

classes.name: PhotoRow
classes.description: Internal data class representing a row of photo metadata from query.

classes.name: EncodedJpeg
classes.description: Internal data class for holding JPEG encoding result.

classes.name: PhotosHandler
classes.description: Main class handling photo retrieval, processing, and JSON response construction.

methods.name: PhotosHandler.handlePhotosLatest
methods.description: Handles HTTP request for latest photos, performs permission check, fetches photos, and returns JSON payload.

methods.name: PhotosHandler.parseRequest
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters into PhotosLatestRequest object.

methods.name: queryLatestRows
methods.description: Queries MediaStore for latest photo entries.

methods.name: decodeScaledBitmap
methods.description: Decodes and scales bitmap from URI within max width constraints.

methods.name: encodeJpegUnderBudget
methods.description: Encodes a Bitmap into JPEG Base64 string, respecting size and quality constraints.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates optimal inSampleSize for Bitmap decoding based on max width.
